locator: I q.3 a.5 co., second proof: Ostendit autem Philosophus in III Metaphys., quod ens non potest esse genus alicuius
interpretation: Read as Aquinas' acceptance of Aristotle's conclusion: being is not a genus (strict sense). 'Genus alicuius' (a genus of anything) is not weakened; the Lean statement says only that being is not a genus, which is what the second proof uses.
